payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison of single-system performance against system combination methods, highlighting the advantages of single-system approaches in terms of training data efficiency and word error rates (WER).

claims.text: The single-system approach achieved a WER of 41.6% on DEV and 43.2% on EVAL, which is a significant improvement over previous single-system results without system combination.
Using a single acoustic model with less training data (308hrs) resulted in better performance compared to a system that used 4500hrs of training data without system combination.
The single-system approach allows for faster and cheaper training of acoustic models compared to system combination methods.
